text: At start, help panel, CHORES list, NEXT line and a centred caption all draw over each other in the lower-left; the caption ('Your house is beside you...') is unreadable under the help text.
Wheel prompt while throwing is wider than the 640px screen: clipped on both sides ('ng a water jar [#...] stay at the') and drawn on top of the CHORES heading.

Aiming B at a pot is fiddly: pots sit low on a shelf, the HUD covers the left two thirds of the screen, and B on a miss gives no feedback at all. Took ~5 tries; also the clay lens darkens the scene so the pots are hard to see.
Performance: 'pt wait 20' (20 s game time = 20 game minutes) took about 2.5 minutes wall-clock headless; waiting for sunset on the ghat is the bulk of a session.

Good: steady look at the first snake on the dusk path turns it into a coiled rope within ~3 game seconds; Fear drops 8->4 and a codex page arrives. Readable and satisfying, though the snake was half-hidden behind the HUD text block.

Codex: page titles in the left list are cut off ('The rope and the sna', 'The space in the po'). The verse page itself (Gaudapada Karika 2.17-2.18, Devanagari + IAST + English) is lovely; footer says 'Working translation ... awaiting review'.

Reaching the village end of the path: NEXT stays 'Walk back to the village along the path' with no distance/direction any more and does not advance; the player is left without guidance on what completes it.

After sleeping (E at the indigo door) it is 22 March 6:30 am, but the NEXT line says 'Wait on the ghat steps for the sunset' in the morning, no after-mode or V hint is shown, and the view is near-black (inside the house).

Morning after the rope: pressing V (inside the house and again outside) does nothing visible and no text explains why. If V only works in an after-mode not yet reached, the screen never says what unlocks it; the NEXT line loops back to the sunset wait.
